slots.selection_rule: Each round pick 23 slots (4 players: 14 S + 9 M). An M needs a slot whose allowed_classes has M. Check max_item_size_m ([width, depth, height] in the item frame, front = facing) against the model; place the model base centre on the slot point and turn it so its front faces facing_unity_xz (Blender: rotation_blender_z on the model root). Never place the same model on two slots closer than neighbour_rule_m (horizontal); the preview also gives the deepest M slots the most valuable models.
